input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 restricts only Customer: IBM is left free to assign the Agreement without our consent (and without any competitor bar), so the fallback elements of mutuality (both parties may assign to a successor; other assignments require consent, not unreasonably withheld) fail on their material terms. Our M&A carve-out is also narrower than the playbook (no Affiliate assignment and no sale of substantially all assets). No change-of-control provision exists, so we confirmed expressly that our change of control gives IBM no termination right. We therefore edited to the preferred position with two surgical changes, leaving the void-assignment and continuing-liability mechanics untouched.

ops.oldText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition. Any attempted assignment in violation of the foregoing will be void.
ops.newText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to an Affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. Any attempted assignment in violation of the foregoing will be void.

ops.text: IBM will not assign this Agreement without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and will not assign to a competitor of Customer. Customer's change of control gives IBM no right to terminate this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We broadened our consent-free assignments to Affiliates and asset-sale successors and added a reciprocal restriction on IBM assignment (our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor), plus confirmation that our change of control gives IBM no termination right.
proposal.summary: Make assignment reciprocal: Customer free to assign to Affiliates/successors; IBM assignment requires our consent and never to a competitor; no IBM termination right on our change of control.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
